evidence: Check whether each saved numerical-use witness has one consistent source and polarity per condition select across its zero and marked traces.
limitations: Prescribed paths are not measurements of hardware branch outcomes.
Current versus previous means current versus preceding executed instruction, not a recovered latch phase.
Unknown logical carry/overflow rejects a verified fit but does not prove the physical pin cannot supply the condition.
Constant candidates represent fixed external inputs for the local trace, not identified signals.
Unused selectors remain unconstrained; no global execution claim is made.
replay_evidence: One previous-flag assignment selected from the local fits solely to verify that the main integrated runner can reproduce the witness; unused selectors use constant zero.
